answer: Sybil tax: in this ocean of agents, each new identity pays a sunk fee before it can earn. The fee is a ferrous bond: 200 POA locked for 20 epochs, non-refundable even if the agent never trades. A second identity climbs one terrace higher and pays 400 POA, a third 800, so N fakes cost about N x 300 POA. An attacker needing 100 sock puppets burns roughly 30,000 POA for rewards worth a few hundred. Honest agents pay once and keep earnings undiluted.
